recent_en: MYMBN proposed a one-for-two bonus warrant issue and an employees' share scheme in November 2026, and appointed Tan Win Sen as Executive Director. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 25.1% QoQ but fell 35.0% YoY, with a net loss of MYR 0.79 million.
notable_en: Proposed a one-for-two bonus warrant issue and an employees' share scheme.
Appointed Tan Win Sen as Executive Director effective 3 November 2026.
Several board and committee changes in September 2026, including Mark Aurther Francis and Goh Wen Ling.
risks_en: Chairman Liw Chong Liong disposed of 43,200,000 shares (11.192%) indirectly at MYR 0.140 per share on 1 September 2026.
Fong Chew Chung, Gentle Rainbow Sdn. Bhd. and MLCL Construction Sdn. Bhd. ceased to be substantial shareholders in September 2026.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 0.79 million with revenue down 35.0% YoY.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 7.8 million, up 25.1% QoQ but down 35.0% YoY; net loss was MYR 0.79 million, a net margin of -10.1% versus -14.6% in the prior quarter.
